name: Gala Icons
about: Gala Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 55 icons designed by Jake Wells. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under GPL.

faqs.q: Are Gala Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 55 Gala Icons are open source under the GPL license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the GPL terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Gala Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Gala Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 55 icons in the Gala Icons set, designed by Jake Wells. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Gala Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Gala Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
